meta.title: Why You Can’t Buy The Best Converse Sneakers. (and how maybe you can)
meta.description:
Ah yes Converse sneakers. You're probably familiar with the classic Chuck Taylor's or even the Chuck Taylor 70's (which I reviewed!). These however are based slightly off the One Stars which are equally cool. Anyways...

Subscribe! Follow me on instagram! (@8thWeekday)

So I don't have a large sneaker collection BUT I think these are the best Converse sneakers around, no doubt in my mind (that's not true I have doubt). These are the low tops but they also came in hi tops too. Either way they are amazing and I wish they weren't discontinued so I could wear them more without being nervous about losing them forever. 

In this video I chat about the fit, the style, and their history with the Korean War. I also of COURSE do a waterproof test.

Boots these shoes are based off of: Bunny Boots & Mickey Mouse Boots.
